力量、有氧和 HIIT，有什么区别？: How are strength, cardio, and HIIT different?
力量训练常被称为“无氧训练”，但各种运动都会不同程度地使用有氧与无氧供能。HII: Strength training is often called anaerobic training, but all exercise uses aerobic and anaerobic energy to different degrees. HIIT describes high-intensity work alternating with recovery. It is not simply another name for combining cardio and strength, and a mixed circuit is not automatically HIIT.
按体能等级选择适合的难度：入门可以从低冲击、较温和的循环开始，不必追求高强度。常: Choose a difficulty that suits your fitness level. Beginners can start with gentler, low-impact circuits without aiming for high intensity. Regular sessions take about 15 minutes; some cardio options take 30 minutes.
